Subject (in full) STEINER, M.M. Baroness - Movements of.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY

Date 17. 9. 39.
September 17, 1939.

Subject The Baroness Martha Maria STEINER.

Made by. J.P.S.Killingbeck Forwarded by R. W. Macaulie D.S.I

On September 2, 1939, a communication
emanating from the United States Treasury Department
Washington, D.C. was received by the Police Authorities
of the French Concession, Shanghai. The message was to
the effect that a German national named Baroness
Martha Maria STEINER, a drug and espionage suspect,
Sailed from Vancouver, British Columbia, on the s.s.
"Empress of Asia" on August 20, 1939. Her destination
was given as China.

Baroness Steiner arrived in Shanghai on
board the s.s. "Empress of Asia" on September 4, 1939,
and took up residence at the Cathay Hotel, Nanking
Road.

On the day of her arrival she dispatched
a telegram to 'A.M.BRUSSET', Banque Franco Chinoise,
Peking and has since sent further telegrams to the
same person. The messages contained in the telegrams
were all of a personal nature and included nothing
that could be regarded as suspicious. One telegram
stated that she was unable to arrange a trip to Peking
while a later telegram was in the nature of a request
asking 'A.M.Brasset' to try and arrange the trip and
itinerary for her.

During the evening of September 4, the
Baroness dined at the Cathay Hotel with the purser
of the s.s. "Empress of Asia". She has been observed
on various occasions frequenting the "Hollywood
Gardens", Yu Yuen Road, in the company of German Jewish

1939年9月17日。

主题 Martha Maria STEINER 男爵夫人。

制作者：J.P.S. Killingbeck 转呈者：R. W. Macaulie 副督察

1939年9月2日，上海法租界警务当局收到一份来自美国华盛顿特区财政部的公函。该函件大意称，一名名为 Martha Maria STEINER 男爵夫人的德国国民，涉嫌毒品及间谍活动，于1939年8月20日从不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华乘坐“亚洲皇后”号轮船启航。其目的地申报为中国。

Steiner 男爵夫人于1939年9月4日乘坐“亚洲皇后”号轮船抵达上海，并入住南京路华懋饭店。

抵达当日，她向北京中法银行（Banque Franco Chinoise）的“A.M. BRUSSET”发送了一封电报，此后又向同一人发送了更多电报。电报内容均属私人性质，不包含任何可被视为可疑的内容。其中一封电报称她无法安排前往北京的行程，而随后的一封电报则是请求“A.M. Brusset”尝试为她安排行程和路线。

9月4日晚，男爵夫人在华懋饭店与“亚洲皇后”号的管事（purser）共进晚餐。有人多次观察到她与德籍犹太难民一同出入愚园路“好莱坞花园”（Hollywood Gardens），并于9月14日被看到在华懋饭店与一位名叫 Jackie Miss 的女士共进午餐，此人曾是愚园路跑马厅夜总会（Jockey Night Club）的老板，并曾在愚园路百乐门舞厅（Paramount Ballroom）担任酒吧侍者。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科）
（批：归档 阅 9月19日。）

refugees and on September 14 was seen lunching in
the Cathay Hotel with one Jackie Miss, one time
proprietor of the Jockey Night Club, Yu Yuen Road,
and who was at one time employed as a barman at the
Paramount Ballroom, Yu Yuen Road.
A reception clerk at the Cathay
Hotel alleges that he knew the Baroness Steiner some
ten years ago, in Berlin and states that she then
enjoyed the reputation of being a 'Second class
demi-mondaine'.
(Copy to D.)
Baroness Steiner, who is reputed to
be of German-Austrian descent, is due to leave on
the s.s. "Tsingtao Maru" on September 18, en route
to Peking via Dairen. The French Concession Police
have notified the French authorities in Peking of the
probable arrival of the Baroness and have requested
that a check be kept on her movements whilst she is
in Peking.
There is no record of Baroness
Steiner on file at Police Headquarters, nor have the
French Police any record of her movements prior to
her arrival in Shanghai on September 4, 1939.
J. Killingley

华懋饭店的一名接待员声称，他大约在十年前在柏林认识 Steiner 男爵夫人，并称她当时享有“二流半上流社会女性”（Second class demi-mondaine）的名声。

警察总局档案中没有 Steiner 男爵夫人的记录，法租界巡捕房也没有她在1939年9月4日抵达上海之前的行踪记录。
J. Killingley

September 14th, 1939.

Is any information available concerning
a woman whose name is believed to be BARONESS
Von STEINER now staying at the Cathay Hotel
and who arrived in Shanghai in the last Empress?
This women has bright red hair and was seen
lunching in the Hotel on September 14th with
Jackie WEISS, ex barman at the Paramount and
ex proprietor of the Jockey Club on Yu Yuen
Road. She is alleged to be a German subject
enroute for Peking.

Y.

（批：D. P. S Killigrew
Paul 15/9.）
pages.zh:
1939年9月14日。

是否有关于一名据信名为 VON STEINER 男爵夫人的女子的信息？她现住在华懋饭店，是乘坐上一班“皇后”号轮船抵达上海的。
这名女子有一头鲜红色的头发，9月14日被看到在饭店与 Jackie WEISS 共进午餐，Weiss 是前百乐门酒吧侍者，也是前愚园路跑马厅俱乐部老板。据称她是一名前往北京的德国臣民。

Y.

（批：D. P. S Killigrew
Paul 9月15日。）
